name: Aggie Ice Cream (USU Logan, UT) Classic Caine Dairy Pure Vanilla Bean Dish
brandOrRestaurant: Aggie Ice Cream (Utah State University, Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: The baseline classic of USU creamery! Pure milk and cream with Madagascar vanilla bean extract. Zero seeds, zero nuts, zero cookies, and zero artificial colors.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a single baby scoop in a cup; take a lactase enzyme tablet if lactose sensitive.
